title: Let a procedure delegate one step to a coding-agent session
description: As a Tactus author, I want to hand one bounded step to a Claude Agent SDK coding session from inside a procedure, so that I get Hankweave-style autonomous coding steps while keeping Lua control flow, Human.approve, budgets and tests. Done when: a documented primitive runs a coding-agent session in a sandboxed workspace, checkpoints its result, counts its spend toward the run budget, and is mockable in specs. Needs a design pass first.
